summary: Beyond Meat filed an 8-K reporting entry into warrant agreements with Big Geyser, Inc. in connection with a distribution agreement. The warrants allow Big Geyser to purchase up to 4,166,667 shares (0.8% of outstanding common stock) at $0.60 per share. This is an equity-linked incentive for a distribution partner, not a standalone special situation. The filing describes terms of two tranches but no board recommendation or advisors are named. Warrants are exercisable for 18 months and are not transferable. This is a routine commercial agreement with a warrant component, not a transformative event.
